brand.about: We have cut and stitched for other labels for seventeen years. The cloth, the tables, the pattern masters and the finishing line are ours; the name on the collar never was. This is the same floor, under our own name, with nobody in between.
brand.logoNote: The brand band at the top of every page. EMPTY means the drawn lockup in brand.js is used, which is what ships. To use a real logo: put the file in app/img/ and set this to its path relative to app/ -- "img/logo.svg". SVG is strongly preferred; a PNG needs to be about 3x the displayed height (so ~170px tall) or it will look soft on a phone. data.pl FAILS if this names a file that is not on disk, so a typo is a check failure and not a broken image a customer finds. A LEADING SLASH ALSO FAILS: a root-relative path works locally and breaks on GitHub Pages, which serves from a subpath. The band sets the height and leaves the width free, so any aspect ratio drops in without moving the page.
brand.name: Vastra Apparel
brand.tagline: Made on our own floor. Sold with nobody in between.

coupons.note: Exactly ONE of percent / flat per code -- data.pl fails on both or neither. minItems is measured on the ITEMS total BEFORE any discount, because a discount code must not be able to unlock itself. Matched case-insensitively with spaces stripped, since nobody types a code carefully. Set active:false to withdraw a code without losing the record of it.

gateway.note: SEE CLAUDE.md. While keyId is empty, card and net banking stay DISABLED WITH THE REASON ON THE CONTROL -- never hidden. A hidden option reads as a shop that does not take cards; a disabled one with its reason reads as a shop still setting up. data.pl FAILS if live is true while serverBase is empty: a gateway without a server cannot verify a payment, and flipping one boolean must not be able to make this site claim otherwise. It also FAILS on an rzp_test_ key with live true.

placeholderNote: WHILE THIS IS TRUE, data.pl FAILS. The brand name, the brand story, the year, every contact field and all three prices are INVENTED -- realistic, not real. The owner has not chosen a name yet. A phone number that does not dial and a GSTIN that is not yours are the worst things to ship by accident on a real business site, so this flag makes shipping them impossible rather than merely inadvisable. Set it to false only when every field in `contact` is real and the prices have been checked. data.pl then checks every contact field is non-empty -- including returnsAddr, which a shop selling to strangers must publish and a kirana delivering down the lane never needed.

returns.note: ⚠️ SEVEN DAYS FROM DELIVERY, NOT FROM PLACEMENT. `from` is `delivery` and nothing may change that to `placed` without the owner saying so: a parcel that takes ten days to arrive would otherwise have its return window expire three days before it landed. This means `deliveredAt` MUST be stored the moment the status becomes `delivered`, and the window is counted from that stamp. ⚠️ `free: true` IS A COST, NOT A FEATURE -- for a manufacturer with no reverse logistics it can mean eating the courier both ways on a ₹700 kurti. NOT YET CONFIRMED WITH THE OWNER. Until it is, this number is a promise the app is making on their behalf.

shipping.note: DELIVERY IS FREE EVERYWHERE -- fee 0, freeOver 0. ⚠️ That makes the free-shipping threshold rule DORMANT, which is exactly how the same rule hid a real disagreement in kirana for months: its domain.js measured the threshold after the coupon and its money.pl measured it before, and both were invisible because both numbers were zero. money.pl here therefore pins the rule against a SYNTHETIC fee and threshold, so the check keeps testing the rule rather than testing zero. freeOver is measured on the ITEMS total, BEFORE any coupon: a discount code must not win free shipping a basket had not earned. deliveryDays is the five-to-ten-day promise, in ONE place, so changing it is an edit and not a code change -- and it is FROZEN INTO THE ORDER at placement, never recomputed on the tracking screen. basis `working` means Monday to Saturday, excluding Sunday.

men-shirt.fit: Regular fit. Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape level. If you are between two sizes, take the larger.
men-shirt.label: Men's shirts

women-dress.fit: Relaxed through the body. Length is measured from the shoulder seam to the hem. If you are between two sizes, take the larger.
women-dress.label: Dresses

women-kurti.fit: Straight cut, not fitted. Length is measured from the shoulder seam to the hem. If you are between two sizes, take the larger.
women-kurti.label: Kurtis

sizeChartsNote: ⚠️ THE CHEAPEST RETURN PREVENTION THERE IS. Most clothing returns are fit, so this table is not decoration. Measurements are BODY measurements in inches -- what the customer measures on themselves -- not garment measurements, and the product page says so, because the two differ by the ease allowance and a customer who assumes the wrong one orders the wrong size. One chart per garment type rather than per product, because a shirt in M is the same M across every shirt on this floor; repeating five rows on every product is how the numbers drift apart. A product names its chart with `sizeChart`, and data.pl FAILS if the chart is missing or does not carry a row for every size that product sells -- a size with no row renders a blank line in the table, which is worse than no table. Row keys are the size ids from the catalogue, not the labels. ⚠️ THESE NUMBERS ARE INVENTED, like the prices. They are a realistic Indian grading, not this manufacturer's own spec sheet. Get the real grading before anybody orders from it.

upi.note: A DELIBERATELY UNRESOLVABLE id. `example` is not a real UPI handle, so no payment app can find a payee and money physically cannot move. While demo is true the pay block wears a visible amber strip saying so. data.pl FAILS if demo is true and the handle after the @ is a real one (ybl, okaxis, paytm, ...), because a demo id on a live handle could send a customer's money to whoever owns it. To go live: put the real id in and set demo to false -- the strip disappears by itself.
